title: Next.js
description: Full-stack React with the App Router from fundamentals to production: file-system routing, layouts, templates and navigation, data fetching, static vs dynamic rendering, Route Handlers, metadata and next/image, Server Components and streaming Suspense, Server Actions, async request APIs, Partial Prerendering and Data Access Layers, declarative caching with 'use cache', after() and instrumentation.ts, Parallel and Intercepting Routes, Node.js proxy.ts and migrations.
